messages.subject: Re: Challenge in fitting a spatiotemporal model with INLA
parts:
Hi colleagues,

I am learning fitting spatiotemporal models using INLA and I simulated some data for Malawi. 

However, when I am fitting my model, I keep on encountering an error message indicating failing to fit my random function due to ' non-numeric argument to binary operator'. So I am stuck and I do not know how to fix this error.

To reproduce my error, you can access my project here: https://github.com/Kalondepatrick/spatiotemporal

The main script is titled core and it is in the folder scripts. 

Thanks in advance.

Patrick

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: Challenge in fitting a spatiotemporal model with INLA
parts:
Dear Patrick,
This error is not related to inla. Looking at your code I can see that you have a comma in the middle of the formula. My suggestion is for you to use

res <- inla(cases ~ f(idate, model = 'iid') +
              f(idarea, model ='besag', graph = malawi_graph),
            family = "poisson", Ntrials = pop, data = map_sf2, verbose = T)

best regards,
Elias
